# DustyThready

**Tailoring + Enchanting, woven together.**

A World of Warcraft *Forever* addon that tells you what to craft next, what it disenchants into,
where to train, and how to turn it all into gold.

---

## Why

Tailoring and Enchanting are the classic "no gathering needed" pair: cloth drops from the humanoids
you're already killing, Tailoring turns it into green items, and Enchanting turns those greens into
the dust it needs to level. Guides explain this on a web page. DustyThready keeps it in the game,
works it out from **your** skill, bags and level, and stays out of your way.

Design rules:

- **One glance is enough.** The *Today* tab answers "what do I do now?" for both professions.
- **No menus to learn.** Five tabs (a sixth, *Endgame*, appears at skill 250), almost no settings.
- **Live, not static.** Counts come from your bags and bank, prices from Auctionator's last AH scan.

## Features

| Tab | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Today** | Both professions: skill bar with your trainer cap, the next recipe and how many crafts are left, your materials (have / need), a one-click **Craft** button (enchants let you pick the item to enchant first), alerts like *Train Expert now*, *Buy Formula: Minor Mana Oil*. A **Thread & Dust** card explains how your next crafts feed the other profession, and what you're short of. |
| **Roadmap** | The full 1-300 path for each profession (Forever-specific, including the new Runecloth Cuffs and Mote of Magic recipes). Done steps fade out, your current step is highlighted (with its **Craft** button), alternatives are indented. Enchanting has a *Strange Dust* or *Magic Essence* route. **Shopping list** shows what you still need up to your current cap and can create an **Auctionator shopping list** in one click. |
| **Disenchant** | Every green/blue/purple weapon or armor in your bags, what it will turn into (with odds), what to do with it (*disenchant it for your Enchanting*, *disenchant and sell the dust*, *sell it on the AH* or *vendor it*) and why, with a **one-click Disenchant** or **Sell** button. A *Cheat sheet* view shows the whole disenchant table, with your level's rows highlighted. |
| **Where** | Your next stops (trainer, formula, pattern), every trainer by rank for your faction, recipe vendors, vendor-only supplies, and where each cloth drops by level. Click any NPC name (here, in Roadmap notes or Today alerts) to see it pinned on your world map. |
| **Endgame** | Shows from skill 250: Mooncloth cooldown for all your tailors, crafts that pay at 300, patterns and enchants worth chasing and where they come from. |
| **Gold** | Money ideas for a low-budget player: disenchant instead of vendoring, enchant for tips (writes your trade-chat ad), sell surplus dust, crafts that sell with a live profit estimate, bolts vs raw cloth, where to farm cloth at your level. |

Also:

- **Item tooltips** show what any green/blue/purple disenchants into, its value vs the vendor, and,
  on reagents, how many your remaining steps still need.
- **Recipe colours**: Today and the Roadmap know when your recipe turns yellow, adjust the crafts
  left, and suggest a better recipe you know or can make from your bags.
- **Disenchant next key**: bind it in Options > Keybindings > AddOns > DustyThready and press it to
  disenchant your greens one by one. Items worth more on the AH are skipped.
- **Enchanting for others**: open a trade and a panel lists the enchants you can put on the customer's
  item, the mats they should bring, a fair tip, and a *Post my menu* button.
- **Alts and mailbox**: material chips show what your other characters and your mailbox hold.
- **Session line** in the footer, **cloth farm hints** in chat when you enter a good zone.
- **English, German, French** (follows your client; machine-assisted translations).
- **Minimap button** (drag to move; right-click opens *Disenchant*) and the **addon compartment** entry.

## Install

Easiest: install it from **CurseForge** with the CurseForge app.

By hand: download the zip from the latest
[GitHub release](https://github.com/gdevxy/dustythready/releases), extract the `DustyThready` folder into
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`, then restart the game or type `/reload`.
(If you clone the repository instead, name the cloned folder `DustyThready`.)

Optional: install **Auctionator** for AH prices, profit estimates and shopping lists.

## Commands

| Command | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `/dusty` | Open / close the window |
| `/dusty de` | Open the Disenchant tab (`gold`, `road`, `where` work too) |
| `/dusty minimap` | Show / hide the minimap button |
| `/dusty reset` | Re-center the window |
| `/dusty forget <name>` | Forget a deleted character's materials |
| `/dusty locale deDE` | Force a language (`frFR`, `enUS`, `auto`) |

## Data sources

Leveling paths, trainers, recipe sources and the disenchant table follow the WoW Forever guides on
[wow-professions.com](https://www.wow-professions.com/forever/) (enchanting, tailoring, disenchanting
and trainer pages). Item IDs and recipe IDs are Forever IDs. Cloth farming spots and money tips are
community knowledge. Counts are estimates: once a recipe turns yellow/green you may need a few more.

## For developers

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/gdevxy/dustythready/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the code is organised, and the WoW Forever API quirks.
- [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/gdevxy/dustythready/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): local setup, testing checklist, how to update game data.
- [docs/PUBLISHING.md](https://github.com/gdevxy/dustythready/blob/main/docs/PUBLISHING.md): releasing on CurseForge (and Wago / GitHub).
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gdevxy/dustythready/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

# Changelog

## v1.2.0

- **Recipe colours.** Today and the Roadmap show whether your recipe is orange, yellow, green or
  grey at your skill (WoW Forever values: Forever moved many Tailoring recipes). Crafts left are
  counted point by point ("about N" once it turns yellow), and Today tells you when to switch:
  *Turned yellow: switch to X (orange, you know it)*.
- **Works from your bags.** When an alternative recipe fits what you carry (or is cheaper at today's
  AH prices), Today recommends it and the Craft button crafts it.
- **Budget to the next cap.** *Reaching 225: about 14g at today's prices. You have 9g; short 5g,
  mostly Silk Cloth.* On the shopping list and the Today cards (needs Auctionator). The shopping list
  subtracts the bolts you'll sew yourself.
- **One profession only?** Today shows a full card for the one you have and a slim hint for the other.
- **Disenchant next key.** Bind *Disenchant next item* (Options > Keybindings > AddOns > DustyThready)
  and press it to disenchant your greens one by one. It never fires in combat or mid-cast.
- **The Disenchant tab tells you what to do with each item**, in this order:
  *Disenchant: your Enchanting needs these* (the reagent you're still short of, and how many),
  *Disenchant and sell the reagents* (worth more than the vendor pays),
  *Sell on the Auction House* (worth more than its reagents) and *Sell to a vendor*. Each row says
  why in one line, the summary lists the counts ("Disenchant 3 items for your Enchanting, Sell 1 on
  the Auction House..."), and the Today tab and item tooltips give the same advice. The advised
  action is the bright button: **Disenchant**, or **Sell** (one click while a vendor is open).
  Disenchanting stays possible on sell rows as a quiet button; the *Disenchant next* key only takes
  items worth disenchanting. **Keep** is now **Hide**. Soulbound items never show an AH price.
- **Recipe tooltips.** Patterns and formulas say whether you know them, when your path needs them, or
  that they're not on your path.
- **Enchanting for others.** Open a trade: a panel next to the trade window lists the enchants you
  know for the item in the *Will not be traded* slot, with mats, what the customer should bring, and
  a fair tip. **Enchant** casts it on their item. **Post my menu** writes your enchant list to chat.
- **Endgame tab** (shows at skill 250+): Mooncloth cooldown for all your tailors with a "ready"
  alert, crafts that pay at 300, patterns and enchants worth chasing and where they come from.
- The **Gold** tab's first card shows the same disenchant / sell / vendor counts.
- **This session** in the footer: skill-ups, dust gained, and gold saved vs vendoring.
- **Cloth farm hints.** Entering a zone where humanoids drop the cloth you need prints one chat line
  (can be turned off in settings).
- **Alts and mailbox.** Material chips show *(+15 alts)* or *(+5 mail)* when you're short, with
  who has what in the tooltip. Alts are remembered once they log in (or read from Syndicator).
  `/dusty forget <name>` removes a deleted character.
- **German and French.** The addon follows your client language; `/dusty locale deDE|frFR|enUS|auto`
  forces one. Translations are machine-assisted: corrections welcome.
- Recipes a trainer teaches (like Enchant Cloak - Greater Defense) now say which trainer rank teaches
  them and who, on Today, the Roadmap, the Where tab's next stops and the Craft button's tooltip.
  Once you've opened a profession, missing ones show as "Not learned" even with the window closed;
  before that, the button says **Open** instead of offering to craft a recipe you may not have.
- Fix: **Craft ×N** made only one when the profession wasn't open yet. Now the first click opens it
  and the next one crafts them all.

## v1.1.0

- One-click crafting: a **Craft** button on the Today cards and on your current Roadmap step. It opens
  the profession if needed and crafts what the step still needs (as far as your bags allow;
  shift-click crafts one).
- Enchants that go on an item let you pick the target first (bags or equipped, cheapest first), then
  **Enchant** applies it.
- Recipe icons on Today and the Roadmap link to chat: shift-click for the crafted item,
  shift-right-click for the pattern/formula (or the recipe when a trainer teaches it).
- NPC names (trainers, pattern and formula vendors, supply vendors) are links: click one to open the
  world map on its zone with a pin on the NPC (right-click the pin to remove it). TomTom gets a
  waypoint too. Positions come from QuestieDB's Forever data.
- Fix: shift-right-click on a recipe icon now links the pattern (it did nothing).
- Fix: shift-click item links and *Write my ad* use the client's current chat API.

## v1.0.0

First version.

- Today tab: what to craft next for Tailoring and Enchanting, materials have/need, training and recipe alerts,
  "Thread & Dust" synergy card.
- Roadmap tab: Forever 1-300 paths for both professions (Strange Dust or Magic Essence route for Enchanting),
  shopping list with Auctionator export.
- Disenchant tab: bag scan with odds, value vs vendor, one-click disenchant, cheat sheet.
- Where tab: trainers, formula and pattern vendors, supplies, cloth farming spots, filtered by faction.
- Gold tab: money ideas with live Auctionator prices.
- Disenchant and reagent info in item tooltips, minimap button (LibDBIcon), addon compartment entry.
